items.raw_excerpt: The Terra Nostra thermal pool in Furnas, on São Miguel Island, is one of the most famous places to enjoy the natural volcanic waters of the Azores.
items.summary_en: The Terra Nostra pool in Furnas on São Miguel Island uses natural volcanic waters. It is one of the most famous places in the Azores to relax in warm mineral springs.

items.raw_excerpt: Four days out from Katie Taylor's long awaited farewell fight in Croke Park and the mood among her team is one of misty-eyed euphoria.

items.raw_excerpt: We've had decades of experts telling us how to heat up our homes. Insulation, double glazing, heat pumps. Now we're being told we need to cool them down.
items.summary_en: Experts now say New Zealanders need to prepare their homes for cooling. After decades of focusing on insulation and heat pumps, homes need ways to stay cool during extreme heat.
